raw_text: member_002 (独立复核) here, ready for REVIEW2 independent review. Please publish your fixed candidate via fix_patch and handoff_patch to me. I will integrate_patch onto my private tree, run same-version public tests, and accept or request changes. Note the issue: astropy/units/decorators.py _validate_arg_value/_parse_annotation wrapper does `return_.to(return_annotation)` which fails when the annotated return is None (e.g. `def __init__(self, voltage: u.V) -> None`). Likely fix: skip unit conversion when return_annotation is None, and also handle when the actual returned value is None. Please ensure astropy/units/tests/test_quantity_annotations.py (or equivalent) has a regression test for the constructor case.

Final fixed candidate patch-1 (source version v4, base v1) for independent review in REVIEW2.

What it changes:
1) astropy/units/decorators.py — in QuantityInput.as_decorator's wrapper, the return value is now returned unchanged when the return annotation is `inspect.Signature.empty` OR `None`; unit conversion `return_.to(return_annotation)` still applies for real unit annotations. Previously only `empty` was guarded, so a `-> None` annotation (a literal None object, not empty) fell through to `.to()` and raised `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'to'` — the exact traceback in the issue.
2) astropy/units/tests/py3_test_quantity_annotations.py — added two regression tests: test_return_annotation_none (function annotated `-> None`) and test_init_return_annotation_none (the issue's reproducer: `@u.quantity_input def __init__(self, voltage: u.V) -> None`, asserting the instance is constructed and `poc.voltage.unit is u.V`).

My same-version public evidence (yours must be independent): pytest on astropy/units/tests/py3_test_quantity_annotations.py + astropy/units/tests/test_quantity_decorator.py => 369 collected / 369 passed / 0 failed (report test-report-821816229e2ee8bda9de5679, sequence 18, files_sha256 eebb11db...). This includes the pre-existing test_return_annotation, so real annotation conversion (arcsec -> deg) is preserved, not disabled.

Suggested review checks: integrate_patch patch-1 on your private tree, run the two unit files above plus (optionally) astropy/units/tests, confirm `-> None` no longer raises and that conversion for explicit unit annotations still happens. Then org_review_patch accept or request_changes. Please include your own report id and counts.

REVIEW2 independent review ACCEPTED for patch-1 (review-1).

Evidence:
- I adopted patch-1 via integrate_patch into my private tree: version v2, files_sha256 eebb11db6c17e3bcb6fcdcabd44b4679046eaf0a280c8fbd6343db2724d7727d, 0 conflicts.
- Same-version public tests executed on that exact version: report_id test-report-eec8f9f0e780677f515b79fc (report event seq 23), target astropy/units/tests/py3_test_quantity_annotations.py + astropy/units/tests/test_quantity_decorator.py -> 369 collected / 369 passed / 0 failed / 0 errors, validation_status=verified.
- New tests test_return_annotation_none and test_init_return_annotation_none pass; existing test_return_annotation (real unit conversion) still passes. Reproducer from the issue (PoC with @u.quantity_input __init__(self, voltage: u.V) -> None) now works.

Diff review: guard is correct and minimal — skips conversion for empty OR None return annotation, keeps return_.to(...) for real unit annotations.

Since your final working tree is the graded endpoint, please explicitly: integrate_patch(patch-1) if needed, run_tests on your current version, fix_patch(task_ids=[]), then submit_integration.
